entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi David. This VeloBand Pulse you sold me is a complete piece of garbage and I want a refund immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A technical fault? The thing is just **not working**! It's completely **broken**. It charged once and now it's dead. And before it died, it **won't sync** with my phone at all. This thing is **defective** and I want my money back.

Okay, thank you for that detail. It sounds incredibly frustrating to have a new device fail like that, and I apologize for the experience. Based on what you're describing—that it won't hold a charge or sync—it sounds like we have a technical issue.
I don't care what you call it! I paid good money for something that works. Are you going to give me a refund or not? This is ridiculous! I want to speak to your manager!

I understand you're angry, and you have every right to be. For a defective device like this, our process is to connect you directly with our Technical Support team. They are equipped to troubleshoot the device and, if they confirm it's a hardware fault, they can authorize an immediate replacement for you.

No! No more talking! I'm not getting passed around to another department. This is terrible service. I'm going to go online and tell everyone how VeloFit sells broken products and then refuses to stand behind them!

I can assure you, that is not my intention. My manager would follow this exact same procedure. A transfer to the tech team is actually the fastest way to get you a working device. They can approve a replacement on this very call, which is much quicker than processing a return and having you place a new order. I want to solve this for you right now.
So they can send me a new one? Today?

Yes, once they confirm the fault, they can process the shipment for a brand new unit right away. It's the most direct path to getting you a VeloBand that works perfectly. Would you be willing to let me transfer you to them?
Fine. But if they can't fix it or give me a replacement, I'm calling back, and you and I are going to have a much different conversation. Transfer me.

I understand completely. I'm confident they'll be able to get this sorted out for you. Please hold one moment while I connect you to the VeloBand technical team. Your reference number for this call is 78-45-11.
